title: Canonical truncation projection on affine derived sections
statement: For a qcqs f:X→Y with positive higher direct image zero on all quasi-coherent modules, an object E∈D_QCoh(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category] and i∈ℤ, the canonical projection E→τ≥i E induces an isomorphism on the degree-i derived-section module presheaf restricted to the full affine-open category [def-pc-derived-section-presheaf]. This compares E and its truncation, not E and H^i(E).

source.place: Tag 08D4 (3) with N=1 and the canonical truncation triangle; Tag 08D5 affine-open argument

proof.text: Fix an affine open V. Write S for direct image followed by forgetting to presheaves, A for exact evaluation at V followed by forgetting modules, and F=S⋙A. It is sections over f⁻¹V and preserves countable products. Positive quasi-coherent derived functors vanish by the inverse-affine-open vanishing theorem.
The strictly lower truncation K=τ<i E remains quasi-coherent and is supported in degrees ≤i-1. Apply the existing unbounded cohomological bound with N=1 to deduce H^i(RF K)=H^(i+1)(RF K)=0.
Apply RF to the distinguished truncation triangle and use the two vanishing endpoints to make H^i of its second map invertible.

Compare R(S⋙A) and RS⋙mapDerivedCategory(A) by the common K-injective model of the source. Exact evaluation commutes with homology. Natural-isomorphism conjugacy transports invertibility to evaluation of the stated presheaf map, and the forgetful presheaf functor reflects isomorphisms. No K-injective resolutions on the presheaf target are required. The cited exact-functor theorem supplies mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso. The K-injective comparison itself is the explicit composition of rightDerivedFunctorIsoKInjectives, mapHomotopyCategoryCompIso and mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh written in Lean, not an unproved existence assertion.

theorem qcoh_acyclic_derived_sections_truncation_isIso {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (hacyc : ∀ (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)),
      F.IsQuasicoherent → ∀ (p : ℤ), 0 < p →
        IsZero ((schemeModuleHigherDirectImage f p).obj F))
    (i : ℤ) (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) :
    IsIso ((PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀
      (ObjectProperty.ι (fun V : Y.Opens ↦ IsAffineOpen V))
      (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).obj).map
        ((schemeDerivedSectionPresheaf f i).map
          ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGEπ i).app E.obj)))
